limitations: One Sponza scene plus four training photo identities; three different photo identities stay in validation at two emissions. First-reset frames only, not representative game or temporal validation.
No temporal training or quality validation.
Torch timing excludes D3D12 integration and is not a hidden-demo benchmark.

output_grading.scope: Unfitted algebraic approximation from the same runtime controls; other camera views reuse the parameters by inference.
output_grading.training: Differentiable FP32 operations after the clamped learned residual.
output_grading.inference: FP16 network, FP32 grading, FP16 final storage; all included in graph timing.

comparison.timing_scope: Full-1080p FP16 network plus output grade; no D3D12/application integration.
limitations: One 3D scene, optionally supplemented by static photograph planes; no representative game or temporal acceptance.
Validation identities stay out of fitting, but previous validation scores have informed research choices; not an independent final test set.
Pixel metrics do not establish preserved perceptual quality. No replacement is accepted.
Four extra training photo identities and three excluded validation identities are a small exploratory extension, not representative game sequences.
Earlier validation results informed data collection; these are not independent final-test results.

The original >=1 fraction included above-one values, so it was not an exact count of clipped channels. Calibrated photos have no exactly-one values; the lake has one above-one channel value. Negative filtering overshoots also remain.
Complete student graph timings exclude application integration; sparse native timings are a separate scope. No native model or kernel speedup and no accepted replacement.
